verdict.rationale: Cake documents an MCP connection that is read-only by design (cake-equity-docs-27), and admins can control what human stakeholders see (cake-equity-docs-14). Neither shows a way to issue scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent: a fixed read-only mode and stakeholder visibility settings are adjacent features, not credential scoping. No public API spec was found (cake-equity-probe-2).
